sources.role: native properties, keyboard-profile, frontend roots, and host input backends

paths.path: bluemsx.ini in the current directory when readable, otherwise <writable-root>/bluemsx.ini
paths.naming: Native INI API uses root config; properties include joy1.type, joy2.type, joystick.POV0isAxes, and keyboard.configFile.
Windows profiles are native INI input-event maps; DirectInput joystick values use runtime J<n> tokens.
evidence: source:Src/Win32/Win32keyboard.c keyboardLoadConfig/keyboardSaveConfig and DirectInput enumeration @ aef17c6

paths.naming: The Windows frontend assigns board SRAM to its SRAM directory; mapper filename is content-dependent.

paths.path: User-selected native savestate filename; QuickSave uses <writable-root>/QuickSave
paths.naming: The save-state dialog supplies the filename; quick-save actions use QuickSave.
Machine firmware is selected through machine resources; no universal BIOS filename/checksum is asserted.
No key file or checksum is claimed.
evidence: source:blueMSX source tree frontend inventory @ aef17c6

windows.notes: The Windows frontend is the source-backed full desktop path; physical joystick identity remains runtime-only.

paths.naming: blueMSXlite passes its current directory as the native properties root.
SDL/Linux keyboard profile save/load is disabled and archJoystickGetCount returns zero in SdlInput.c.
evidence: source:Src/Sdl/SdlInput.c profile block and archJoystickGetCount @ aef17c6

paths.naming: blueMSXlite assigns board SRAM to SRAM.

paths.path: <current-directory>/QuickSave for quick-save actions; other paths frontend-selected
paths.naming: QuickSave is explicitly created by blueMSXlite.
Machine and database resource roots are explicitly set by blueMSXlite.
No key file or checksum is claimed.
evidence: source:blueMSX source tree frontend inventory @ aef17c6

linux.notes: This is the repository's blueMSXlite Linux frontend, not proof of a packaged full desktop blueMSX build.

linux-flatpak.reason: The pinned source contains a Linux blueMSXlite frontend but no first-party Flatpak package.

macos.reason: The pinned source does not provide a macOS frontend contract.
